dict.string: Cadence maintains a continuous Bluetooth connection to your Meta Gen 3 AI Glasses for Freeze-of-Gait rhythmic auditory cueing and fall detection.
Cadence uses the iPhone camera only when you choose it. Pill reference photos are saved on this phone; surroundings photos are sent to your Cadence server for a description.
Cadence connects to the Cadence server on your Mac and receives photos from your Meta glasses when you request them.
Cadence attaches your GPS coordinates to caregiver SOS alerts if a fall occurs while the app is running in the background.
Cadence attaches your GPS coordinates to caregiver SOS alerts only when a fall is confirmed.
Cadence uses the Meta AI Glasses and iPhone microphone for voice check-ins after a suspected fall, vocal volume tracking, and the Guided Home Motor Exam.
Cadence reads iPhone motion to detect freezing of gait and falls when the glasses motion stream is not available.
Cadence uses on-device Apple Speech recognition to listen for "I'm okay" or "Help" during the 30-second post-fall check-in when recognition is available.
